description: HydroShield: An AI-Powered Water Infrastructure Resilience Platform for EU Utilities is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mohammad Zeeshan (Eötvös Loránd University). HydroShield is an AI-powered water infrastructure resilience platform for European water utilities, addressing floods, pollution events, and droughts. It fuses live Copernicus Sentinel satellite data (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, Sentinel-3 thermal) with weather, hydrological, and sensor data to deliver real-time risk visibility, and automatically generates NIS2 Directive- and CER Directive-compliant incident reports. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
